changes: Updates now arrive inside the app: no more files to sideload.
Fixed the source icon for HentaiHaven.
Sharper errors when a server is waking up, instead of blaming Wi-Fi.
Countdowns to new episodes. Home has a Next episodes row for the shows you watch and save, with a live timer to each one's next episode.
If a show you watched has finished but a new season is airing (like Black Clover Season 2), it counts down to the new season.
Every airing show's page shows when the next episode comes out, ticking down in days, hours, minutes and seconds.
New Schedule page: the whole week of new episodes, day by day, with a My shows filter.
Fixed strange symbols in a few labels, like “What’s new”.
Sign-in works again: accounts now run on a hosted server that keeps your data across restarts.
Nothing needs your PC to stay on any more.
The app finds a working server by itself if one ever goes down.
New source: HentaiHaven (18+), with its own icon and English subtitles.
